column2: Heh heh heh...
Win, and you stand to make a fortune.
But everyone gathered in this $$闘技場$$ is a battle-hardened warrior who calls himself the strongest...
And soft nonsense like withdrawing from a match because of an injury, or fouls...
There's none of that here!!
Even if your arms are torn off, your guts split open, and you vomit $$血$$, both of you keep killing each other until one of you dies!
I'll put a fat wager on the one who'll never make it back alive!
...Sorry!
Though it was just how things turned out, I got even you involved in something this stupid...
As you've guessed, I was raised to become a $$剣闘士$$...
No... perhaps it would be more accurate to say I was made to be one...
That might be the more fitting way to put it...
After all, I've never even seen my parents' faces...
Most $$剣闘士$$s are gathered by the rich to flaunt their power to other rich people—
a collection of powerful $$奴隷$$s. But...
If they lost, they were always killed right there!!
So finding $$奴隷$$s who could keep on winning was no easy task...
Before long, the question of whose child they were began to matter...
I've heard my parents were powerful fighters once called the $$剣闘界の帝王$$ and the $$桜の女王$$...
Both were forced to remain $$剣闘奴隷$$s into old age...
In the end, they passed on...
Children are put up for $$セリ$$ as soon as they're born, so I suppose they couldn't remember every child's face...
Even so...
They could do nothing but keep fighting just to survive...
Nothing but struggle to gain strength their whole lives...
Honestly, I pity them from the bottom of my heart...
We children born to families with black $$羽$$ are all taught this in church...
Humans are, at heart, no different from the many other animals living on this earth.
Nature's great principle of $$弱肉強食$$ is the unchanging truth of all things,
and the strongest person left standing in the end is the one who is right...
But the strength we speak of does not simply mean physical power...
It includes economic power and strength of mind... even the kind of charm that draws people in!
For proof, even if physically weaker, someone who can hire $$傭兵$$s and assassins—
a merchant with that kind of wealth...
is hardly ever killed so easily...
From the moment people are born,
they differ in athletic ability, looks, sex... and the wealth of their parents and regions.
Each person grows up under his own distinct, deeply unequal conditions and circumstances...
Those conditions can never be made equally the same from the starting line...
You can understand that, can't you?
Yet, depending on one's own efforts...
one can acquire the power called knowledge through learning and broadening one's understanding...
And if one can gain the wisdom and experience to put that knowledge to use...
one can gain a power far greater than the disadvantage of an unequal starting line...!
That is why we must live by another ideal that is important to us:
to live honestly with our own $$欲望$$...
After all, every pursuit improves...
as the old saying goes: "What one loves, one excels at."
That is why we...
are taught to fight every hypocrisy in $$この世$$ and always speak from the heart!
Hey... It's about time for you lot to take your turn!!
